title: Line Mafia
description: A drawing liar game for 3–10 players. Everyone gets the secret word except the mafia, who only knows the category. Take turns adding one line each to a shared drawing, then vote on who was faking it. Catch the mafia and the town wins, unless the mafia guesses the word. Play with friends using a room code, hit Quick Play to join players from around the world, or practice alone against computer players who draw from real doodles.
